title: Hell Guardian
description: This mod for Fabric 1.20.4 adds a custom new end-game bossfight: The Hell Guardian🔥
body:
# Hell Guardian

Join the Runeshard Discord today: https://discord.gg/NSYFkbbjjZ - Would appricate every single new member!

The Hell Guardian is a Mod created by Runeshard Studios which will provide you following:

- A custom, unique bossfight (no new models, all vanilla)
- 1000 HP boss
- Every 12 seconds it spawns five blazes (max. 15 at a time)
- Gear: Sharpness II Iron Sword (unbreakable), Helmet: Carved Pumpkin, Chestplate: Black dyed leather chestplate, Leggings: Black dyed leather leggings, Boots: Black dyed leather boots
- Can not be damaged by projectile when under 50% of health (wither-logic)
- Drops a netherite ingot on death'

**How to summon:**
- Operator: /summon hellguardian:hell_guardian (attached/featured picture) (works in every dimension, but then he doesn't spawn with his signature weapon)
- Like a vanilla snowgolem just: Carved Pumpkin, 2x Coal blocks below
- The building "ritual" does only work in the nether!!!

**Suggestion:** The suggested gear for this mobfight are: Maxxed netherite gear, totems, golden apples, ender pearls.
Note: The project might have minor bugs which will be fixed in the future.
